The Approach

The problem comes first. The solution follows.

Every assignment begins with understanding the circumstances, not selling a predetermined service.

01

Listen

We begin with the client’s account of the situation. What happened? What is the desired outcome? What has already been attempted? What constraints are involved?

02

Understand

We examine the underlying issues, the stakeholders, the practical limitations and the opportunities that may not be immediately visible.

03

Explore

We identify possible approaches: business strategy, creative thinking, commercial evaluation, institutional engagement or specialist professional support.

04

Connect

Where necessary, we identify relevant professionals, specialists, organisations, businesses or institutional contacts who may help advance the assignment.

05

Move Forward

We help structure the next steps and, depending on the agreed scope, coordinate discussions and support progress.

Not every assignment requires every stage. The scope and nature of our involvement depend on the specific situation.

A note on practical solutions

We do not promise that every problem can be solved or that every opportunity will succeed. We do believe that a better understanding of the problem, a wider view of the options and the right people at the right time can make a meaningful difference.

Have a problem that needs a different perspective?

Tell us what you are dealing with. It does not have to fit neatly into one category. Sometimes the first step towards a solution is simply having the right conversation.
